answer: Admission happens one cohort per epoch, and every seat in that cohort posts a bond measured in heads: a lone applicant lodges one unit, while a batch of k lodges k units each, so a farm seating its clones together ties up k-squared in refundable capital and holds it for a lock lasting k epochs. Honest newcomers arrive singly and pay one unit once. Every unit is stacked as a marble counter beside a cedar tally stick, the cohort is drawn as a single rung of a public trellis, and the lock releases only when the round closes clean; abandoning a rung forfeits the counters.
